title: [docs] It would be nice to explain what syntax is used in templates for hits widget
body:
https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hits.html#example

Maybe a link or mention to Handlebar somewhere could help users figuring out where the syntax in the example comes from. Is it Handlebar?

comments.body: Actually it's another implementation of mustache called [hogan](http://twitter.github.io/hogan.js/)
But you're totally right, we should mention that somewhere. (or even every time there is a template)
Thanks a lot, I was helping a user and at some point I realized I wasn't sure what the syntax or the language was ;)
should be easy to link it by every template :)

We made it clearer on the [new Algolia website](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/widgets/customize-an-existing-widget/js/?language=instantsearchjs#templating-your-ui). Feel free to reopen if you think we can make it better!
